usage.summary:
Gate passed on run 2/4: 320,532 states explored, all witnesses reached, and both known-bug probes caught duplicate delivery and filename reuse.

Added the seeded in-memory conformance driver. The hook, model, and ratified statements remain unchanged.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The hook follows these lifecycle steps across at most two tasks and two page mounts.

pins.name: DeliveredAtMostOnce
pins.says: Each task has at most one completed delivery callback across all mounts; rejected callbacks do not count.

pins.name: NamesNeverReplace
pins.says: Completed delivery callbacks for different tasks never use the same statue filename.

pins.name: OneTaskAtATime
pins.says: Within a mount, start and recovery never enter over in-flight work, and the running guard stays held through download and delivery.

pins.name: ClearBlocksFutureRecovery
pins.says: Clear prevents later recovery of its task, while work adopted before Clear may still invoke and complete delivery.

pins.name: ErrorsReleaseTheHook
pins.says: A start, task, download, delivery, or fifth consecutive poll failure settles with its error and releases the hook for another start.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: The sidecar, mount, hook state, dismissal storage, and observation records stay within their declared types and bounds.

pins.name: CanDeliver
pins.says: A successful task can complete its delivery callback.

pins.name: CanDeliverAfterClear
pins.says: An already-adopted task can complete its delivery callback after Clear.

pins.name: CanRetryRejectedDelivery
pins.says: A rejected delivery can later complete for the same task using the same filename.

pins.name: CanStartAfterError
pins.says: After an error the hook can accept another start.

pins.name: ReplayCompletedTask
pins.says: After a reload the unchanged hook recovers a previously delivered task and completes its delivery callback again.

pins.name: ReuseRecoveredName
pins.says: The unchanged hook completes a recovered task under recovered-statue.stl after a different task was delivered under that name.

usage.summary:
I found one problem: hard-coded bounds prevent coverage from growing with the model.

- [conformance.ts:83](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-1792578715/conformance.ts:83): task creation is capped at literal `2`; reload likewise uses `2` at line 110. Lines 376–378 only select task IDs 1–2, and line 340 only records those tasks. There are no named `MaxTasks` or `MaxMounts` constants for the gate to increase. Consequently, a larger-bound check cannot exercise the additional tasks or mounts, or record the enlarged task domain.

The operation selector itself is state-independent. I read the model, driver, loader, and manifest; the imported hook source is absent from this snapshot, so I could not verify its implementation parameters. Nothing was changed.
